cards.title: Top AI Agents Now Available in Text Messages
cards.body: TechCrunch compiled a list of the most notable AI agents that can operate within text messaging platforms. The agents range from general assistants to specialized tools for families, travel, and work use cases.

cards.title: Actors License Faces to AI Microdrama Startups
cards.body: An actor has licensed his face to a microdrama startup in a trend already popular in China. Experts raise concerns about long-term consequences if this practice becomes mainstream in Hollywood.

cards.title: Daniel Ek Backs AI Researcher's Fusion Power Startup
cards.body: Spotify founder Daniel Ek is investing in Europa Fusion, a fusion power startup founded by an AI researcher. The startup is developing advanced fusion energy solutions.

cards.title: AI Solves 167-Year-Old Riemann Hypothesis Problem
cards.body: An AI system has claimed a solution to the century-old Riemann hypothesis, stunning mathematicians. A competing human solution has also emerged simultaneously.

cards.title: Space Data Center Financing Faces Major Challenges
cards.body: Lenders are hesitant to finance chips destined for space due to concerns about collateral in orbit. This reluctance could impact the broader space data center industry.

cards.title: Nvidia Reports Growth Despite Jensen Huang Scandal
cards.body: Nvidia delivered solid earnings with healthy growth despite the ongoing fallout from CEO Jensen Huang's departure. The company announced it will cease selling H200 chips in China.

cards.title: Six AI Gadgets to Upgrade Your Home Office
cards.body: TechCrunch reviewed six AI-powered tools designed to enhance productivity in home office settings. Options range from intelligent notetakers to AI-enhanced webcams.

cards.title: Apple Developing Its Own Mac-Based AI Agent
cards.body: Apple appears to be building AI agents capable of competing with Meta Muse, Instinct, Claude, and OpenAI Dots. The agent would operate directly on Mac systems.

cards.title: Anthropic Founders Pocket $280M Each in IPO
cards.body: Anthropic's seven founders collectively cashed out nearly $2 billion in a record-breaking IPO at $83 per share. The company raised nearly $105 billion in total capital.

cards.title: Meta's Muse Charm Wearable Could Cost $300
cards.body: Meta's upcoming AI wearable device may carry a $300 price tag, according to reporting from The Information. Meta declined to confirm but said it will share details soon.

cards.title: Recent Tech Outages Mirror Y2K-Style AI Issues
cards.body: Recent outages affecting airline bookings, banking, and productivity platforms may reveal a deeper pattern, according to cybersecurity experts. The incidents suggest systemic vulnerabilities in AI-dependent infrastructure.

cards.title: Jensen Huang Resigns from Nvidia Amid Scandal
cards.body: Jensen Huang has stepped down as Nvidia CEO following an affair, potentially impacting U.S.-China AI competition. The scandal could have national security ramifications.

cards.title: Anthropic IPO Could Deliver $156B to Charity
cards.body: At a projected stock price of $95, Anthropic's Public Benefit Foundation, employee donations, and company matching could total $156 billion. This demonstrates the company's philanthropic commitment structure.

cards.title: Google's Gemini Agent Now Controls Your Mac
cards.body: Google updated Gemini with an AI agent capable of organizing files, filling out forms, and managing multistep workflows on Mac. The agent brings advanced automation to desktop productivity.

cards.title: Meta's Muse Agent Mixes Conversations, Exposes Data
cards.body: Meta's AI agent Muse has been reported surfacing private messages, career advice, and financial data belonging to other users. The issue raises serious concerns about data privacy and agent accuracy.

cards.title: Everful Raises $48.5M for Retail Sourcing Platform
cards.body: A startup founded by a former Alibaba executive has raised $48.5 million to expand its factory-direct sourcing platform. Everful connects retailers with Chinese manufacturers for product sourcing.

cards.title: Anthropic Nasdaq Debut Hits $111, Surges 33%
cards.body: Anthropic's stock opened at $111 on Nasdaq, representing a 33% jump from its $83 IPO price. The company raised over $80 billion in new capital.

cards.title: Anthropic CEO Commits to Pacing AI Development
cards.body: During Nasdaq's opening bell, Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei reaffirmed the company's commitment to deliberate AI development pacing. This stance remains firm regardless of business or political pressures.

cards.title: Anthropic IPO Tests AI's Circular Financing Model
cards.body: Anthropic's public debut challenges the circular financing ecosystem where infrastructure partners like Amazon and Google profit regardless of outcomes. The company faces massive compute commitments post-IPO.

cards.title: Superhuman Expands Go Agent to Docs and Mail
cards.body: Superhuman is positioning Go as its central AI agent and expanding availability to Docs and Mail applications. The move centralizes agent capabilities across the platform.

cards.title: New Report Shows AI Capabilities Still Improving Exponentially
cards.body: METR's updated evaluation finds AI models continue improving along exponential trajectories, particularly in coding tasks. However, models still lag behind in tasks requiring nuanced judgment.

cards.title: AI Hype Index: AI Spreading Everywhere in Tech
cards.body: AI integration is becoming ubiquitous across consumer products and services. Google's AI Overviews already cost the company billions in lost ad revenue.

cards.title: AI-Powered Electronic Nose Matches Human Smell Detection
cards.body: An AI startup in New Jersey trained a machine learning model on chemical analysis and human sensory notes to detect odors. The system now matches human olfactory capabilities.

cards.title: Meta Reconsiders 2030 Net-Zero Goal Amid AI Emissions
cards.body: Meta's AI data centers are driving record emissions, forcing reconsideration of net-zero commitments. The energy demands of AI infrastructure pose significant environmental challenges.

cards.title: Researcher Plants Canaries in AI Supply Chain
cards.body: A security researcher embedded tracking data into AI supply chains and uncovered major privacy vulnerabilities. The exploit reveals how training data can be manipulated without detection.

cards.title: Google Launches New Search Homepage With AI Chat
cards.body: Google rolled out an updated search interface featuring integrated AI chat and removed the traditional search button. The redesign represents a major shift toward conversational AI search.
